name: archboard-geometry
responsibility: Holds the points, boxes and routes that the renderer core's layouts route by and its painters draw by: rounds a routed polyline into a curve, and every coordinate in one place
description: The archboard-geometry crate (ADR 0091), 17 names: Point, Rect, Segment and Curve with the operations every crate shares (curve_through rounds a routed polyline into a curve), and a route measured along its ink and shortened (route.rs: route_length, segment_length, shortened_by), the part of a line a pulse rides. Geometry only the layout uses (a route read backwards, route equality at drawn precision) lives in archboard-layout's private routes/curves.rs.

outgoing.label: round and compare as JavaScript does
